in argocd/projects/. tests/test_consumer_appproject_policy.py fails if any name listed
WHY. deploy-prod.yml re-applies every file in argocd/projects/ on each deploy (#1147),
and argocd-register.yml applies the product's own copy. Two writers for one object is
last-write-wins: whichever ran most recently is what the cluster enforces. For FuzeFront
that meant deploys that flapped and then froze from 2026-10-02 (#1278), visible only by
The registration gate (scripts/validate_consumer_appproject.py, rule R2) also refuses a
consumer project FuzeInfra holds - but only when that consumer next registers. This file
catches the re-addition in the FuzeInfra PR that would cause it.
Moving a project to its product: delete argocd/projects/<name>.yaml AND add it here in
the same change. The live object is not pruned (deploy-prod uses kubectl apply), so the
product's copy takes over at its next argocd-register run, after passing the gate.
